I am a postdoctoral scholar in the Department of Public Health Sciences at the Medical University of South Carolina, working with [Dr. Souvik Seal](https://sealx017.github.io/). My current research is focused on developing statistically accurate methods for biomarker identification and dimension reduction in single-cell and spatial omics, with a focus on multi-sample analysis.

I received my Ph.D. in Statistics from Texas A&M University (2024), advised by [Dr. Matthias Katzfuss](https://sites.google.com/view/katzfuss/home).

### Research interests
- Biomarker discovery in single-cell and spatial omics.
- Multi-sample spatial omics and spatially aware dimension reduction.
- Scalable Gaussian processes and Bayesian computation.
- Bayesian spatial nonparametric estimation.
